privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Diziel collects, protects, and handles shipper and carrier data.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.body: We collect necessary information to facilitate freight operations including: contact details, commercial registrations, driver licenses, vehicle specs, and pickup/drop-off coordinates.

telemetry.title: 2. GPS Telemetry & Live Geo-Tracking
telemetry.body: Diziel utilizes live satellite telemetry during active shipments to ensure cargo safety, verify route milestones, and provide accurate ETAs to verified parties.

usage.title: 3. How Data Is Used
usage.body: Data is used solely to execute freight dispatches, process digital waybills, compute transparent tariffs, and comply with Egyptian transport regulations.

sharing.title: 4. Authorized Information Sharing
sharing.body: Trip details are only shared between authorized shipment parties (Shipper, Assigned Driver, Fleet Agent). We never sell user data to third-party advertisers.

security.title: 5. Data Security & Encryption
security.body: We implement bank-grade encryption protocols to safeguard all documents, financial settlements, and digital waybill records against unauthorized access.

rights.title: 6. User Rights & Updates
rights.body: Users may request corrections or updates to their stored profile data by contacting our operations support team or via their account portal.

pricing.title: Pricing Policy
pricing.subtitle: How shipment prices are computed inside Diziel.

basis.title: Basis of Pricing
basis.body: The indicative price is computed from distance (km) × weight (t) using a Diziel-approved tariff table, with adjustments based on truck type and service category.

distance.title: Distance
distance.body: A unified Google route is used to measure distance from pickup to drop-off and is the source of truth for the invoice.

margin.title: Diziel Margin & VAT
margin.body: A 5% Diziel margin is added on top of the base price; 14% VAT is then added when applicable to the order.

extra.title: Extra Expenses
extra.body: Road, loading, unloading, government, port, and customs fees are tracked separately, and the payer (Client or Diziel) is selected per order.

downPayments.title: Down Payments
downPayments.body: New clients: 10% deposit before truck dispatch. Trusted clients: 50% on loading, balance on unloading. Long-term contracts: deposit handed to the driver.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.body: If insurance is requested, an insurance premium is added to the total based on the declared cargo value.

adjustments.title: Adjustments & Discounts
adjustments.body: Any discount or adjustment is admin-only and is recorded on the order with a reason.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Diziel app — terms and conditions. Please read carefully.
terms.footnote: Contact us through the app's official support channels.

s1.title: 1. Definitions
s1.body:
Application: the Diziel app and all its associated services.
User: any person using the app, whether a client or service provider.
Agent: an accredited transport company that provides trucks and is the operational manager for its fleet.
Driver: any person registered in the app to provide transport services.

s2.title: 2. Eligibility
s2.body:
Users must be at least 18 years old to have legal capacity to contract.
Users are required to provide accurate, up-to-date data; they alone bear responsibility for any errors.

s3.title: 3. Account Creation
s3.body:
A personal account must be created before using the app.
The user is responsible for keeping their account credentials confidential.
The app reserves the right to reject or suspend any account.
No account is activated until provided data is verified.
Forged or incorrect documents result in immediate suspension and referral to authorities.

s4.title: 4. Nature of Service
s4.body:
The app provides a smart platform connecting clients with service providers for cargo transport.
Prices and delivery times may vary based on trip conditions.

s5.title: 5. Pricing & Payment
s5.body:
Trip value is calculated according to the published tariff inside the app.
Payment may be made in cash or electronically via available means.
The client must settle trip dues without delay; otherwise financial penalties apply.
The app may adjust prices before a trip starts based on market variables.
A 1% per-day late-payment penalty applies to any overdue balance.
The app may freeze any account's balance during a dispute until the issue is resolved.

s6.title: 6. User Obligations
s6.body:
Respect service providers (driver, technical support, customer service).
Preserve the truck at loading and unloading sites.

s7.title: 7. Driver Obligations
s7.body:
Comply with traffic laws.
Abide by user conditions at loading and unloading sites.
Follow user instructions to ensure everyone's safety.
Adhere to departure and arrival schedules.
Maintain vehicle cleanliness and personal appearance.
Follow the route shown on the app map.
Protect cargo integrity throughout the journey.

s8.title: 8. Cargo Liability (Insurance & Compensation)
s8.body:
The app provides cargo insurance policies for users.
If the user opts out of insurance, they bear full responsibility with no claims against the app.
Any damage must be reported within 24 hours — later reports will not be accepted.
Reporting must be done via the app or the officially recognised email.

s9.title: 9. App Liability
s9.body:
The app is a technical and operational intermediary, not the primary carrier.
The app bears no direct responsibility for events beyond its control.
The app is not liable for driver violations or illegal cargo during a trip.

s10.title: 10. Amendment of Terms
s10.body: The app may amend these terms at any time. Continued use constitutes acceptance of amendments.

s11.title: 11. Agent Obligations
s11.body:
Agents must provide high-quality vehicles and qualified drivers.
Agents must monitor trip execution on the app and coordinate at all stages.

s12.title: 12. Cancellation or Postponement
s12.body:
Cancellation before truck dispatch: no charge.
Cancellation or postponement after dispatch: EGP 75 per kilometre.
Delay at loading or unloading: EGP 500 per 6 hours of delay.

s13.title: 13. Tracking
s13.body:
The user must consent to geo-tracking of the shipment during the trip.
The user must consent to storage of shipment data.
Calls and chats may be recorded for quality and security purposes.

s14.title: 14. Privacy & Responsibilities
s14.body:
The app is committed to protecting user data and not using it for any unauthorised purpose.
The user is solely responsible for the contents of cargo being transported and ensuring it does not violate Egyptian law.
The app does not transport pets, cash, gold, alcohol, or any otherwise prohibited items.
Violating these rules makes the user solely responsible before Egyptian law.

s15.title: 15. Ratings & Penalties
s15.body:
A rating system applies to drivers, agents, and clients.
Warning first, then account suspension.
Immediate suspension for fraud, forgery, manipulation, abuse, or financial evasion.

s16.title: 16. Governing Law
s16.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

s17.title: 17. Force Majeure
s17.body: Includes accidents, natural disasters, earthquakes, revolutions, wars, political decisions, road closures, and similar events. In such cases the app bears no obligations toward users.

s18.title: 18. Intellectual Property
s18.body: Everything related to the app — logo, systems, operational rules, and visual identity — is the exclusive property of Diziel and may not be contested by anyone.

s19.title: 19. Contact & Support
s19.body: You can reach support via: Email — Facebook — WhatsApp.
